scope: WP13 generated corpus of simple spherical triangulations with minimum degree 5, orders 21-60 plus Goldberg-Coxeter GC(2,1) of order 72. Facts about the graphs only.

format.rotation: list of n lists; rotation[v] is the cyclic neighbour list of vertex v (0-indexed). Face convention as longtable/mass_core.validate_triangulation: dart (a,b) -> (b, succ_b(a)). Equivalent to plantri ASCII with letter chr(97+v); the ASCII form cannot express n > 26, so 'ascii' is null for n > 26 and the JSON rotation is authoritative.
format.root_types: for each degree-5 vertex r: n5, n6, n7plus = numbers of neighbours of degree 5, 6, >=7
format.isomorphism: no two entries are isomorphic as plane maps up to reflection (canonical BFS code)
